Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Zelu Halai: 30-year-old woman, 158 cm (short), plus-size heavy construction with substantial natural mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: round full face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: shaved temple geometry. Wardrobe: layered-wrap, specifically overlapping wrap panels, an off-center waist tie, divided trousers, and soft boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette marigold-green. Visible personal details: a narrow tattoo cuff; a dense freckle field. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: uses small rhythmic repeats of the palette. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
